problem_type: Component teardown incorrectly owns an external editing session
symptom: Both whiteboard entrances open then immediately close in development StrictMode; virtualized nodes close on unmount.
direct_cause: InlineWhiteboard cleanup calls closeWhiteboard without a matching setup; pending debounce reads a detached child ref.
class_root: External business sessions must outlive replayable and virtualized view lifetimes; session owner must enforce explicit document boundaries.
affected_population: Whiteboard card and image-toolbar editors in StrictMode, HMR and virtualized canvas views
entry_points: Canvas node removal and project release

external_sources.purpose: Cleanup must undo setup; setup-cleanup-setup must preserve observable behavior.

invariants: Only explicit finish/cancel or invalidation of the session node/project closes the session.
Unmount flushes a captured draft idempotently without requiring a live child ref.
Old project work cannot publish into a replacement project.

door_reduction.why_not: Creator card and toolbar entrances remain distinct; host closes on Done/cancel; base node and React Flow subscribe for rendering; version cards finish before switching versions; InlineWhiteboard registers its finish handler; session owner enforces release and publishes state. Removed the teardown-close door and added session-owned document invalidation.

generality_proof: Both entrances converge on InlineWhiteboard and one session store; lifecycle-independent canvas subscription catches every node removal shape, and registered project release invalidates pending opens.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own opening, explicit closing, node deletion and project release independently of mounted views.
Capture and idempotently flush drafts while teardown only releases view resources.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real card mounted with real editor and real session under StrictMode.
Real toolbar click mounts the same real editor and session in StrictMode.

recurrence.reason: Two entrances, StrictMode replay, HMR and viewport virtualization reach the same cleanup.
same_class_scan: TypeScript AST census: all useEffect/useLayoutEffect return expressions under src/workbench; inspect cleanup business calls.
Check nodeAttachedPanel setup/cleanup symmetry, NodeVideoClipPanel view lifetime and director cleanup exclusions.

prevention.invariant: Session lifetime follows explicit actions and source document lifetime, never component teardown.
prevention.failure_mode: Removed nodes or replaced/released projects synchronously clear session and invalidate queued opening work.
prevention.strategy: Remove teardown close; session-owned canvas observer and project release own invalidation. Capture draft before ref detaches.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove unmount close and ref-dependent pending-draft cleanup in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Installed React 19.3.0 follows documented effect replay. Retain supported runtime; application cleanup violates its contract. Upgrade is not a remedy for this ownership bug.
dependency_lifecycle.target: Next supported React/runtime pair when adopted by the project
exit_criteria: Keep real StrictMode two-entrance regression green on any React/runtime update.

migration: No saved shape changes. Existing state and result identity are reused on remount.
residual_risks: Production/dev real Electron and independent acceptance pending before implementation.
Director cleanup findings belong to the parallel director implementation line; editor-session unification is deferred.
